places.name: Pashupatinath Temple
places.why: One of the holiest Shiva temples and a UNESCO World Heritage site.

places.name: Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple)
places.why: Ancient stupa on a hill with 360° valley views and peaceful vibes.

places.name: Boudhanath Stupa
places.why: Largest stupa in Nepal — the heart of Tibetan Buddhism.

places.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
places.why: Historic palaces, Kumari (Living Goddess) and Newari architecture.

places.name: Patan Durbar Square
places.why: Exquisite stone carvings and Krishna Mandir.

places.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
places.why: Nyatapola temple, juju dhau (king curd) and pottery squares.

places.name: Phewa Lake & Sarangkot
places.why: Boating on Phewa, sunrise over Annapurna from Sarangkot, paragliding.

places.name: Annapurna Circuit
places.why: World-famous trek across Thorong La pass at 5,416m.

places.name: Muktinath Temple
places.why: Sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists at 3,710m with eternal flame.

places.name: Lumbini
places.why: Birthplace of Gautam Buddha — the garden of the world's peace.

places.name: Chitwan National Park
places.why: Jungle safaris, one-horned rhinos, crocodiles and Tharu culture.

places.name: Everest Base Camp
places.why: The ultimate trek to the foot of the world's highest peak.

places.name: Nagarkot
places.why: Panoramic Himalaya sunrise, 32km east of Kathmandu.

places.name: Dhulikhel
places.why: Quiet hill town with beautiful Himalayan panorama.

places.name: Gosaikunda
places.why: Sacred alpine lake at 4,380m, part of the Janai Purnima pilgrimage.

places.name: Langtang Valley
places.why: Glacier valley known as the "Valley of Glaciers", close to KTM.

places.name: Manaslu Circuit
places.why: Remote circuit around the 8th highest peak in the world.

places.name: Rara Lake
places.why: Nepal's largest lake — untouched blue beauty in Karnali.

places.name: Shey Phoksundo
places.why: Deep turquoise lake in a remote Buddhist land.

places.name: Bandipur
places.why: Preserved Newari hill-town with vintage charm.

places.name: Ilam Tea Gardens
places.why: Rolling green tea estates and Kanyam's misty roads.

places.name: Koshi Tappu
places.why: Wetland bird paradise on the Koshi river.

places.name: Khaptad
places.why: Sacred plateau of meadows, forests and peace in the far-west.

places.name: Bardiya National Park
places.why: Wild tigers, river dolphins and pristine sal forests.

places.name: Tilaurakot
places.why: Archaeological remains of the young prince Siddhartha's palace.

places.name: Janaki Mandir
places.why: Magnificent white palace-temple of goddess Sita.

foods.name: Dal Bhat
foods.desc: The national meal — rice, lentil soup and seasonal veg. "Dal bhat power, 24 hour!"

foods.name: Momo
foods.desc: Steamed dumplings with buff/chicken or veg, served with fiery achar.

foods.name: Newari Khaja
foods.desc: The classic Newar platter: chiura, bara, wo, chatamari and yomari.

foods.name: Sel Roti
foods.desc: Sweet ring-shaped rice bread, a must during Dashain and Tihar.

foods.name: Gundruk & Achar
foods.desc: Fermented leafy greens with spicy tomato achar — the soul of hill food.

foods.name: Yomari
foods.desc: Steamed rice-flour dumpling filled with chaku (molasses) — a winter treat.

foods.name: Juju Dhau
foods.desc: Bhaktapur's famous "king of yoghurt" served in clay pots.

foods.name: Dhido
foods.desc: Hearty millet/cornmeal mush, the traditional highland staple.

foods.name: Chatamari
foods.desc: Newari "Nepali pizza" — rice-flour crepe topped with egg and meat.

foods.name: Tongba
foods.desc: Warm millet beer sipped through a bamboo straw in the hills.

languages.name: Nepali (नेपाली)
languages.note: Official language, written in Devanagari script.

languages.name: Maithili (मैथिली)
languages.note: Heart of Madhesh, rich Mithila literature & art.

languages.name: Bhojpuri
languages.note: Widely spoken in the eastern Terai and Madhesh.

languages.name: Newari (नेपालभाषा)
languages.note: Language of Kathmandu Valley Newar community.

languages.name: Tharu
languages.note: Language of the Terai's indigenous Tharu people.

languages.name: Magar
languages.note: Language of Magar communities in the west.

languages.name: Rai (Kiranti)
languages.note: Family of languages in Koshi province.

languages.name: Sherpa
languages.note: Himalayan language, with Tibetan script roots.
